summary: An Israeli soldier has been indicted for passing sensitive military intelligence to Iranian handlers over a year in exchange for cryptocurrency, including base coordinates and photos of interceptors and U.S. refueling aircraft. Houthi forces launched a massive missile strike on Saudi Arabia triggering sirens in multiple provinces including Riyadh. Lebanese daily reports record 27 alerts, 15 drone sightings, and eight artillery shelling incidents across southern districts.
key_points: Israeli soldier arrested in September, charged with espionage for Iran, provided military unit details, base coordinates, photos of interceptors and U.S. refueling aircraft, received cryptocurrency, offered $200,000 to travel to Iran. (Source: @manniefabian/59453)
Houthi terrorists conducted massive missile strike on Saudi Arabia, sirens sounded in several provinces, emergency warning issued for Riyadh. (Source: @shin_persian/11723)

Lebanese daily alert report: 27 total alerts, 15 drone sightings in villages including Burj al-Barajneh and Haret Hreik, eight artillery shelling incidents in Wadi al-Hujeir, Mayfadoun, Kfar Kila, Al-Qantara, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Al-Mansouri, Wadi Zibqin. (Source: @redlinkleb/50490)
Enemy forces dropped smoke bombs on Zoutar al-Sharqiyah road near Al-Afiya rest stop. (Source: @redlinkleb/50502)
Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf stated Iran has repeatedly clarified seven conditions to mediators, progress only after agreement on those conditions. (Source: @N12chat/232393)
Israeli final election results: Netanyahu bloc 53 seats, Change bloc 48, Arab parties 19, no bloc reaches 61-seat majority. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9061)

Netanyahu accused foreign actors of election interference and voter bribery benefiting Arab parties, citing Justice Solberg's remarks on "Ra'amgate," alleging Qatari money involvement without evidence. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9047)
Lebanese Army Engineering Regiment scheduled controlled detonation of war remnants near Deir al-Zahrani municipality. (Source: @redlinkleb/50493)

sections.executive_summary: An Israeli soldier has been indicted for passing sensitive military intelligence to Iranian handlers over a year in exchange for cryptocurrency, including base coordinates and photos of interceptors and U.S. refueling aircraft. Houthi forces launched a massive missile strike on Saudi Arabia triggering sirens in multiple provinces including Riyadh. Lebanese daily reports record 27 alerts, 15 drone sightings, and eight artillery shelling incidents across southern districts.

points: Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf declared Iran has repeatedly and explicitly conveyed seven conditions to mediators, stating progress depends on agreement on those conditions. (Source: @N12chat/232393)

Iranian intelligence handlers recruited an Israeli soldier for approximately one year, receiving sensitive military information including base coordinates, interceptor and U.S. refueling aircraft photos, and a Telegram group for potential recruits, paying in cryptocurrency and offering $200,000 for travel to Iran. (Source: @manniefabian/59453)
UKMTO issued warning 185-26 update 001 and warning 186-26 for maritime security in the region, indicating ongoing naval threats. (Source: @shin_persian/11720, @shin_persian/11726)

Israeli soldier indicted for espionage on behalf of Iran, charged with passing information to enemy with intent to harm state security, contact with foreign agent, and providing military base coordinates, interceptor and U.S. refueling aircraft photos over a year-long operation. (Source: @manniefabian/59453)
Final election results show Netanyahu bloc at 53 seats, Change bloc at 48, Arab parties at 19, leaving no bloc with the 61-seat majority required to form a government. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9061)

Prime Minister Netanyahu accused foreign actors of interfering in elections and bribing voters to benefit Arab parties, referencing Supreme Court Justice Solberg's remarks on "Ra'amgate" and alleging "huge sums of Qatari money" without presenting evidence. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9047)
Former Prime Minister Bennett and former Chief of Staff Eisenkot met to discuss pathways to form a government as quickly as possible. (Source: @N12chat/232386)
National Security Minister Ben-Gvir sharply criticized Police Commissioner Levi following clashes at a Haredi protest, accusing him of appeasing leftists and violating law. (Source: @N12chat/232392)
Military ballot boxes from southern bases were airlifted by Israeli Air Force helicopter to the Knesset due to flooding in Eilat and Arava region. (Source: @manniefabian/59449)

Daily alert report for October 29, 2026 recorded 27 total alerts, 15 drone sightings across villages including Burj al-Barajneh, Haret Hreik, Chiyah, Laylaki, and Ouzai, with highest activity in Baabda (7), Nabatieh (5), and Marjayoun (4) districts. (Source: @redlinkleb/50490)

Eight artillery shelling incidents reported: two each in Wadi al-Hujeir and Mayfadoun, one each in Kfar Kila, Al-Qantara, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Al-Mansouri, and Wadi Zibqin. (Source: @redlinkleb/50490)
Enemy forces dropped smoke bombs on the Zoutar al-Sharqiyah road near the Al-Afiya rest stop. (Source: @redlinkleb/50502)
Lebanese Army Engineering Regiment prepared to conduct controlled detonation of war remnants near the municipality in Deir al-Zahrani town. (Source: @redlinkleb/50493)
Live map updates indicated ongoing artillery shelling at Wadi Zibqin, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, and Mazraat al-Hamra. (Source: @redlinkleb/50489, @redlinkleb/50499, @redlinkleb/50509)

Houthi forces launched a massive missile strike on Saudi Arabia, triggering sirens in several provinces and an emergency warning for Riyadh, according to Saudi Civil Defense. (Source: @shin_persian/11723, @shin_persian/11722)

Houthi shelling of Taiz city and Sabr villages in Yemen involved over 127 ballistic missiles and approximately 29,000 artillery shells over 70 days, targeting civilian facilities and residential areas. (Source: @shin_persian/11725)
UKMTO issued maritime security warnings 185-26 update 001 and 186-26 for the region, indicating potential threats to shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/11720, @shin_persian/11726)
